name: PINEAPP
recent: PINEAPP 于 2026 年 8 月启动最高 4,850,000 股新股的私募计划，9 月 11 日定价每股 RM0.8400，9 月 24 日完成并上市，共筹得 RM4,074,000。公司于 8 月 26 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止的合并业绩。近期没有相关新闻。
notable: 完成私募配售，发行 4,850,000 股新股，每股 RM0.8400，筹得 RM4,074,000。
Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 8 月 28 日批准私募新股上市及报价。
risks: 私募配售发行新股，占发行前股本不超过 10%，对现有股东持股比例有摊薄影响。

recent_en: PINEAPP launched a private placement of up to 4,850,000 new shares in August 2026, fixed the issue price at RM0.8400 per share on 11 September, and completed the placement with listing on 24 September, raising RM4,074,000 in gross proceeds. The company announced its consolidated results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 26 August. There has been no recent news.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 4,850,000 new shares at RM0.8400 each, raising RM4,074,000.
Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of the placement shares on 28 August 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares, representing up to 10% of the pre-placement issued share capital, has a dilutive effect on existing shareholders' shareholding.
